subject_definitions:
<Image 4> is the ONLY image reference and the first frame of the video: an OVER-THE-SHOULDER shot from
behind the host looking at Guo Jia, with Guo Jia as the clear, dominant subject (the host's small, blurred
back / shoulder in the foreground corner). The video opens on exactly this image and the frame stays
IDENTICAL to it for the whole shot — same composition, same OTS framing, same position and appearance of
Guo Jia, same background. NOTHING in the picture changes except Guo Jia's natural speaking, lips and
expression; the blurred host foreground stays still.

<Audio 2> is the VOICE-TIMBRE reference only: Guo Jia uses this voice quality; the line is the text
below.

summary:
One continuous fixed shot, starting from <Image 4> — the over-the-shoulder shot of Guo Jia from behind
the host. As the sharp subject, Guo Jia tells the key beat of the story with comic exasperation — just
half an hour after the boss announced the rule, a bird flew up, startled the horse, and it bolted
straight into the wheat field. Frame locked to <Image 4>.

detailed_description:
Guo Jia, positioned exactly as the dominant subject in <Image 4>, delivers the single line with a dry,
exasperated storyteller's tone — eyes widening slightly, brows raised in a "can you believe it" comic
disbelief as he recounts the bird startling the horse, a small gesture conveying the horse bolting into
the field. His performance stays within the locked <Image 4> OTS framing; the blurred host in the
foreground stays still; the frame does not change.
台词: "曹总刚宣贯完制度不到半小时，田里飞起一只鸟，马惊了，直接窜进麦田。"

overall_soundscape:
Guo Jia's voice (timbre per <Audio 2>) — dry, exasperated, comic storytelling tone; low studio room
tone.
non_diegetic_music:
Low talk-show bed, a light comic beat as the horse bolts.
